description: This Java source file defines the 'OpenmrsFilter' class, a custom web filter for the OpenMRS platform. The filter manages user authentication context, session attributes, locale settings, and integration with the Spring framework, ensuring that user context information is correctly set and cleared during HTTP request processing.
